annotations.title: Read back a saved triage profile

description: Returns a saved fixRAgent assessment by its diagnosis_id (from an assessment, the last part of a fixragent.com/c/<id> link, or the h- code that comes with a fixragent.com photo link once the photo has been added there; with no photo added yet, it reports that there is no result). Read only: it never re-reads the photo, never calls the model and spends nothing from the daily allowance. It takes one id and returns one assessment with no contact details of any kind, the same assessment anyone with its fixragent.com/c/ link can open. It needs no key; if a key is sent, it must be a valid one. Reads are limited to 20 an hour per address, shared with assessments.

diagnosis_id.description: The UUID of a saved assessment, the last path segment of a fixragent.com/c/<id> link, or h- followed by the code from a fixragent.com photo link.

name: get_triage_profile

add_photo_url.description: fixragent.com page where the person adds the photo and sees the full Triage Profile.

handoff_id.description: h-<code>: get_triage_profile reads the result back once the photo is added there.

instruction.description: What to do with a not-assessed reply, and that nothing in it is fixRAgent's.

not_assessed.description: true = nothing was assessed; there is no fixRAgent urgency, trade or finding. Pass add_photo_url on.

problem_text.description: On a not-assessed reply: the words the caller sent, handed back so a photo added in the card goes with them.
